sideB.text:
DESTROY THE FOLLOWING OBJECTIVES:
• BUILD 3 NEW SUPPLY CENTERS
• GET HOLLOW MEN TO DEFECT

A new mandatory objective is enclosed.
We only need to complete this 1 objective in November.
